summary: register reuse and nohardcode in wellman requirements; fixos nohardcode policy; standard adoption pins

delivery.outcome: fixos registers wellmanifest/reuse (S3) and wellmanifest/nohardcode (S0) requirements via `wellman adopt auto` and carries a reviewed .governance/nohardcode-policy.json (from nohardcode 922cc51) that the checker resolves automatically.
nonGoals: No conformance certificate; reuse REUSE-002/006B remain open.
No CI gate for nohardcode yet.
ssot, semver and uriprocess are not in wellman or the managed pack catalog; their pins live in docs/INFORMATION/WELLMANIFEST_STANDARDS.md (ticket-075).

architecture.decision: Use the published wellman adopter for requirements and the nohardcode checker's .governance policy lookup; deviations from the upstream policy are limited to disabled unused engines, NOHARDCODE-007 as warning for CLI terminal output, and repository-specific exclusions.
